notes.title: Buggos MUTATIONS!!!
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 3.10[/h2]

[h2]New[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added in forced mutations that will occur after defeating a planet. These are permanent upgrades for your swarm that can drastically change how a bug or the swarm works.
[*] Added a new song for in level gameplay music.
[/list]

[h2]Update[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased the threat decay for the human AI from 5 seconds to 3 seconds - this means the attack waves should be smaller overall as the total threat is decaying quicker.
[*] Updated the text for mass breeding evolution to say 5% chance instead of 5 chance.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you were able to toggle a spawner when trying to deselect a building ghost with right click.
[*] Fixed the Spore Turrets name and description on the tooltip info panel.
[/list]

notes.title: Warrior Balance and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 3.08[/h2]

[list]
[*] Warrior Mounds spawn number increased from 1 -> 2.
[*] Warrior supply cost reduced from 7- > 6.
[*] Warrior Armor increased from 5 -> 6.
[*] Warrior Health increased from 40 ->  45.


[*] Evo - construction squad - number of builders increased from 15 -> 30.
[*] Updated the danger level of the first planet levels.
[*] Updated the evo chamber to force people to get pustules.
[/list]

[h2]Bug[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a memory leak that was causing some crashes - This took forever to fix…
[*] Fixed a bug with the warrior armor evo not working.
[*] Made some updates to how box selection and the circle selection are rendered - this should increase performance.
[*] Players with a controller plugged in were not getting correct control info for [cameraControls] and [AcceptKey].
[/list]

notes.title: Bugs bugs bugs
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. there are many small updates all bundled together in this post. I am working on fixing critical bugs and balance issues atm. 


[h2]Updates[/h2]

Did a balance pass on world 2 map 1
Did a balance pass on world 2 map 2
Reduced Flamer armor from 5  -> 4
Increased the splash range of defenders from 30 -> 40
Capped fps to 120.
Added in spore artillery descriptions.

[h2]Bugs[/h2]

Fixed a bug where the defender was using the wrong particle effect when splash was upgraded.
Fixed a bug with the evolution chamber where some evos were not wanting to unevolve.
Fixed particles spawning at world 0,0
Maybe I fixed a crash with particle effects?
Fixed a bug with the evo chamber not counting well.
fixed a pathing bug that would lets buggos run outside the map.
Fixed a bug where deleting a spore turret would still spawn spitters.
Fixed a bug where those spitters spawned by the deleted turrets were immortal. This causes so many down stream issues.
Fixed a bug where spore artillery spawning swarmers would mess with enemy target finding
